name: Nuvio PS5
description: Nuvio TV for a jailbroken PS5, with EVO native playback and the interface served by the console itself.
author: Bilawal Riaz
release_notes:
Fixed
- Fix seek stalls on large UsenetStreamer streams after server rate limits.
- Use one HTTP range connection and bounded retries that respect Retry-After.

Install
Download PPSA99997.zip, extract it under /data/homebrew, and register or rescan the title with ShadowMount. Close Nuvio before replacing its files. Existing settings stay in /data/nuvio.

The complete nuvio-ps5-0.1.0-alpha.7.zip package includes the source, build receipt and recovery helpers.
